instruction: Enable a setting to automatically refresh all open tabs every 10 minutes.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have native settings to automatically refresh tabs at specified intervals. Auto-refresh functionality requires browser extensions and cannot be configured through Chrome's built-in settings.
